description: kdk-lab: container image updates as grouped weekend PRs. See docs/komodo-gitops.md#dependency-updates-renovate. Every image-string change recreates the container on merge.

packageRules.description: Local builds (stacks/*/Dockerfile -> kdk/*:latest): no registry to look up.
Patch + digest updates (incl. the first pinDigest wave): one grouped PR for the internal hosts.
Patch + digest updates for stacks on kdk-dkr-dmz-01: separate group, merged first (dmz-proxy -> identity -> rest).
Majors: one PR per package, only after ticking the box on the Dependency Dashboard.
backup-* stacks use postgres only as the pg_dump client (newer client dumping an older server is supported): majors need no dashboard approval and never mix with the DB-server postgres PR.
Auth / edge components: extra label so they are reviewed with the identity stack in mind.
linuxserver jellyfin: 12.3ubu2604-ls56; the ubuNNNN base is kept as compatibility.
NUT: a recreate once shut down kdk-hyp-01. Never a version PR; digest refreshes only, and only on explicit dashboard approval.
NUT digest refreshes: disabled entirely. A NUT recreate once shut down kdk-hyp-01; refresh the digest by hand, on a chosen day, with someone watching (docs/services/nut.md).
Immich database + cache: the tag follows Immich's own release compose (postgres 14-vectorchord, valkey 9); digest refreshes only, never a tag bump here.
python base images (7 Dockerfiles + 7 one-shot compose jobs) and the CI python-version: stay on a release with wheels for every pinned package; 3.14+ is opened by hand after a test build.
GitHub Actions majors (actions/checkout, actions/setup-python): one grouped PR, no dashboard approval; CI-only, no container is touched.

postgres DB servers (identity, jellystat, tandoor): all three run 18 since 2026-10-30. A major is still a dump/restore done by hand in an attended window (docs/runbooks/postgres-major-upgrade.md); Renovate may open the PR, which stays behind Dependency Dashboard approval and is merged only mid-window after the 16-style park step.
